acceptance_criteria.criterion: When firstRunRedirect: true and all setupComponents[].detect() return false, the redirect message is written to stdout and onFirstRun is invoked after 2s timeout.
When any setupComponents[].detect() returns true, showInteractiveMenu proceeds directly to the while loop without any redirect.
waitForSkip(2000) resolves false on timeout and true on q keypress — correct polarity: !false triggers wizard, !true skips it.
Terminal is in non-raw mode when onFirstRun is called (readline prompts work correctly).
No new npm dependencies are added to cli-menu.
cli-menu/CHANGELOG.md has a v1.1.0 entry listing all three new MenuConfig properties.

summary: Added MenuConfig.firstRunRedirect (boolean) and MenuConfig.onFirstRun (() => Promise<string[]>) to cli-menu/src/types.ts.
Implemented waitForSkip(ms) helper in interactive.ts: Promise.race(timeout, q keypress); resolves false on timeout (launch wizard), true on q (skip).
Added first-run redirect block in showInteractiveMenu before the while loop: checks firstRunRedirect + all setupComponents.detect() === false + non-empty array guard.
Terminal raw-mode transitions: enterRawMode before skip window, restoreTerminal before onFirstRun (readline compatibility — AC-4).
Bumped cli-menu version to 1.1.0 in package.json. Added v1.1.0 CHANGELOG entry listing all three new MenuConfig properties.
11 new tests in interactive.test.ts covering ACs 1-4 plus edge cases (empty/absent setupComponents, partial detect). 253 tests total, 0 failures.

comments.note: waitForSkip cleanup on timeout uses clearTimeout but cannot truly remove the keypress listener in the test environment (off is mocked as no-op). The done flag guards against double-resolution correctly. No issue in production.

summary: All 7 acceptance criteria verified and met.
AC-1: Redirect message written to stdout during skip window; onFirstRun invoked after 2s timeout (confirmed by test + fake timers).
AC-2: showInteractiveMenu proceeds to main loop without redirect when any detect() returns true — two dedicated tests confirm correct polarity.
AC-3: waitForSkip resolves false on timeout (→ launch wizard) and true on q (→ skip) — source code reviewed, call-order confirmed by tests.
AC-4: restoreTerminal() called before onFirstRun() — call-order array test confirms correct sequence for readline compatibility.
AC-5: package.json version confirmed as 1.1.0.
AC-6: No new production dependencies — package.json has only devDependencies.
AC-7: CHANGELOG.md v1.1.0 entry lists statusLines, firstRunRedirect, and onFirstRun.
Full regression pass: 253/253 tests pass in cli-menu; 80/80 tests pass in workspace suite.

comments.note: No test covers firstRunRedirect:true with onFirstRun:undefined (would short-circuit silently). The implementation handles it correctly via the `config.onFirstRun !== undefined` guard, but a test would make the invariant explicit.
waitForSkip cleanup note from Developer: process.stdin.off is mocked as no-op in tests; production path is correct. No action needed.
